name: web-fashion-product-list-page-with-hanger-banner-and-filter-sidebar
title: Product list page with hanger photo banner, filter sidebar and 3-column model grid
whatItIs: A grey studio backdrop with a centred serif title 'Product List Page' and a white page beneath: pill filters and search, a banner of shirts on hangers, a sidebar of checkbox filters and a price slider, and a 3-column grid of studio model cards with names, price tags and heart and bag icons.
whatItMeans: Clean and fashionable; consistent grey studio photos make a grid cohesive.
techniques: Use identical grey backdrops in every photo.
Show filters as checkbox lists with counts.
Place price in a bordered tag with icon buttons.
Add a lifestyle banner above the grid.

vocabulary.definition: A card with photo, name, price and actions.
